reason: Sponsor decision of 2026-09-29. Review rounds 3 to 6 of M8-A dealt only with pre-existing outcome paths of the M7 master authority backfill (scripts/r2/backfill_master_authority.py), an operator script that no M8-A code calls. Bundling its acceptance into M8-A made each backfill edge case block M8-A. The two packets are decoupled, and a stopping rule is added.

decisions.m8_a_acceptance_scope: The M8-A independent review accepts or rejects M8-A code, its tests and evidence, and V2-02c (34bd4346), which M8-A depends on and which rounds 2 to 6 accepted. It no longer accepts V2-02d.
decisions.v2_02d_track: V2-02d (40337fe3, 079679fb, fef820c3, 40972905, fc8bda2d) is the executor base's backfill. Its acceptance is a separate V2 review track, recorded in docs/r2/evidence/R2_V2_02D_BACKFILL_SERIALIZATION_2026-09-29.md. It does not gate M8-A, and M8-A does not gate it.
decisions.stopping_rule: A review finding blocks acceptance only if it is a correctness, data integrity, security or acceptance defect in the reviewed packet's scope, tied to a concrete code path. A Low or non-blocking finding is recorded in the packet's evidence (coverage_limits or known limitations) and does not open another review round. A round whose only findings are non-blocking is an acceptance.

m7_prerequisite_changes.executor_base: the commit that adds this twelfth amendment
m7_prerequisite_changes.intermediate_commits: As amendment 11. This amendment changes only docs/.

M8-A.rebase: The M8-A commits on d1f9bf41 are re-applied onto this executor base. The baseline is re-frozen with base_head = this commit.
M8-A.acceptance_rule: M8-A is accepted when its independent review accepts M8-A and V2-02c under the stopping rule. The acceptance_rule entries of amendments 6 to 11 that tie M8-A to V2-02d are superseded.
